repos_data.description: Let your AI agent call your phone and talk to you — MCP servers for live, interruptible voice calls + tiered alerts, using free self-hosted pieces (pjsua2 + whisper.cpp + Linphone). No paid telephony, no extra API key.

An MCP server that provides safe access to your iMessage database through Model Context Protocol (MCP). This server is built with the FastMCP framework and the imessagedb library, enabling LLMs to query and analyze iMessage conversations with proper phone number validation and attachment handling.

repo_meta_data.description: A very simple no-fuss minimalist MCP Server with telephony tools like voice call and sms. This MCP Server can be integrated with LLM applications. Vonage API is used for calls, SMS, Speech-to-Text and Speech Recognition.
